receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from the 'Nottingham Evening Post' - Wednesday 03 July 1935
receipts.receiptText: Wine.— To make Burnet Wine: Put 2 quarts of Burnet flowers, pressed down, and 41b. sugar, gallon boiling water, add juice of 2 oranges and 2 lemons, a few cloves, and an oz. crushed ginger suspended in tho liquor in a muslin bag. When cool, add a piece toast spread with an oz. of yeast, leave 7 days, stirring daily; put in cask and bung lightly. When fermentation has ceased, cork firmly: bottle after three months.
